intro.text: A lighteyes of the past, known for a famous duel of honour against Gulastis.

items.text: Velinar lived during the reign of Sadees and fought his duel with Gulastis using an ulius.
At fourteen, Adolin Kholin bought an antique ulius from the Velinar–Gulastis duel as a gift for Idani, but kept it for himself, nick and all.
